text:
Markerzone ran two headlines about Martin Pospisil and Seattle on Nov. 5: one said he "stirs it up again," the other that Brandon Montour made him pay after a Kraken goalie got run over. That's the reputation. He has 82 hits in 17 games, a huge number.

The hockey under the hits is better than you'd guess. He has 6 points, finishing on schedule (3 goals on 2.67 expected), and the Calgary Herald's Steinberg column says Craig Conroy's patience is paying off with Pospisil and Adam Klapka thriving. The Flames have scored about 4.3 fewer goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice.

The worry is that Calgary takes only 45% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him at five on five while out-shooting teams (53% of attempts). Lots of volume, not much quality. His skating is excellent (89th percentile top speed) and his shot is heavy. Evolving-Hockey's small sample from last season had him facing tough competition (94th percentile) with weak teammates. We project about 15 goals. Just stay on the right side of the line.
headline: Pospisil stirs it up, and scores
